description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). K(k TEXT(20) indexed) with keys abcd0001..abcd0700 inserted ascending (enough to split; all share the bytes of 'abcd'). Then Close, and the bytes of pages 44 to 53 (where the table's index pages land) are read from the closed file. Asks the stored prefix of each index leaf.
